reason: Adds an MCP settings panel that lists configured servers and provides forms for generating or saving MCP server configuration in the global profile configuration.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 设置中提供 MCP 页面，用于查看全局配置中的 MCP 服务器并生成或保存新的服务器配置。
summaries.en: Adds an MCP settings page for viewing servers in the global profile configuration and generating or saving new server configurations.

capabilities: Reads global profile MCP configuration metadata
Displays MCP server configuration details while omitting environment-variable and request-header values
Writes MCP configuration to a profile configuration file when supported
Opens the configuration file and supports copying generated YAML when direct writing is unavailable
